_comment: Public-domain source volumes for data/raw/. Every file here is a Project Gutenberg text mirrored by GITenberg; `node scripts/fetch-sources.mjs` re-fetches them all. data/raw/ is gitignored, so this file is the record of where each poem was sliced from.

sources.title: The Wind Among the Reeds (1899), W. B. Yeats
The Wild Swans at Coole (1919), W. B. Yeats
Songs of Innocence, and Songs of Experience, William Blake
A Hundred and Seventy Chinese Poems (1918), trans. Arthur Waley
The Rubáiyát of Omar Khayyám, trans. Edward FitzGerald
Sappho: A New Rendering (1920), trans. H. de Vere Stacpoole
